newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Circuit sees $2.3 mln Q4 gain.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Circuit sees $2.3 mln Q4 gain.

text.p: Integrated Circuit Systems Inc said Tuesday it would post a one-time gain of about $2.3 million or $0.20 per share on the sale of about 80 percent of its holdings in ARK Logic Inc to Vision 2000 Ventures Ltd.
Integrated said that prior to the sale, it held about 51 percent of the shares of ARK, a privately-owned developer of 3-D technology.
It said the sale was part of a plan to focus on its three primary businesses of data communications, frequency timing generation and custom products.
Integrated Circuit said it would record the gain in its fourth fiscal quarter ending June 29.
Vision 2000 Ventures Ltd is a privately-held Cayman Islands investment holding company.
